runner_guide: Think and compute in small chunks. As soon as a sub-computation is needed, write its complete expression as `<expr> =` and continue from the returned value. Do not finish a manual trace before requesting it. For a short integer program, use a Python fenced cell with print, then `Result:`. Unsupported cells leave your continuation. Verify the setup, program semantics and non-computational reasoning. Engine values after `=` or `Result:` are computed exactly; use as given; do not re-derive or re-check by hand.
